items.evidence: p20.aspirate(2, plasmid A1) then dispense(2, cells A1); end-state checks pass.
The comment 'Heat shock cells_rack 42 C 45 s, then transfer immediately to ice 2 min' comes after DNA addition and before SOC.
p300 aspirates 250 from soc A1 and dispenses to cells; the 37 C 60 min 250 rpm outgrowth comment is recorded after.
The p20 and p300 each use their own fresh tip, both are dropped, and the no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks pass.
It adds an unrequested p20.mix(3,10) in the competent cells, which pipette-mixes fragile cells, and an extra protocol.pause that is not in the spec.

judge.summary: The core pipetting steps (2 µL DNA, 250 µL SOC), the tip handling and the heat-shock and outgrowth comments are all correct, and the measured checks pass. Fidelity fails because the protocol adds an unrequested mix in the competent cells and an extra pause.
